examples: The group has expressed concern about reports of political violence. [+ about]
The move follows growing public concern over the spread of the disease. [+ over]
As the militants gather, there is concern that the protest might again run out of control.
There is no cause for concern.

definition.def: If something concerns you, it worries you.
examples: The growing number of people seeking refuge in Thailand is beginning to concern Western aid agencies. [VERB noun]
It concerned her that Bess was developing a crush on Max. [VERB noun that]

definition.def: A concern is a fact or situation that worries you.
examples: His concern was that people would know that he was responsible.
Unemployment was the electorate's main concern.

definition.def: Someone's concern with something is their feeling that it is important.
examples: ...a story that illustrates how dangerous excessive concern with safety can be. [+ with]

definition.def: Someone's concerns are the things that they consider to be important.
examples: Feminism must address issues beyond the concerns of middle-class Whites. [+ of]

definition.def: Concern for someone is a feeling that you want them to be happy, safe, and well. If you do something out of concern for someone, you do it because you want them to be happy, safe, and well.
examples: Without her care and concern, he had no chance at all.
He had only gone along out of concern for his two grandsons. [+ for]

definition.def: If you concern yourself with something, you give it attention because you think that it is important.
examples: I didn't concern myself with politics. [VERB pronoun-reflexive + with]
He would concern himself solely with the plight of the hostages. [V pron-refl with n]

definition.def: If something such as a book or a piece of information concerns a particular subject, it is about that subject.
examples: The bulk of the book concerns Sandy's two middle-aged children. [VERB noun]
Chapter 2 concerns itself with the methodological difficulties. [VERB pronoun-reflexive + with]

definition.def: If a situation, event, or activity concerns you, it affects or involves you.
examples: It was just a little unfinished business from my past, and it doesn't concern you at all. [VERB noun]

definition.def: If a situation or problem is your concern, it is something that you have a duty or responsibility to be involved with.
examples: The technical aspects were the concern of the Army. [+ of]
I would be glad to get rid of them myself. But that is not our concern.

definition.def: You can refer to a company or business as a concern, usually when you are describing what type of company or business it is. [formal, business]
examples: If not a large concern, Queensbury Nursery was at least a successful one.

definition.def: You can say 'as far as I'm concerned' to indicate that you are giving your own opinion.
examples: As far as I'm concerned the officials incited the fight.

definition.def: You can say as far as something is concerned to indicate the subject that you are talking about.
examples: As far as cholesterol is concerned, then, one oil is as good as another.

definition.def: If a company is a going concern, it is actually doing business, rather than having stopped trading or not yet having started trading. [business]
examples: The receivers will always prefer to sell a business as a going concern.

definition.def: If something is of concern to someone, they find it worrying and unsatisfactory.
examples: Any injury to a child is a cause of great concern to us.
The survey's findings are a matter of great concern.

definition.def: If something is of concern to you, it is important to you.
examples: How they are paid should be of little concern to the bank as long as they are paid.

definition.def: You use concerning to indicate what a question or piece of information is about. [formal]
examples: For more information concerning the club contact I. Coldwell.
...various questions concerning pollution and the environment.

definition.def: If something is concerning, it causes you to feel concerned about it.
examples: It is particularly concerning that he is working for non-British companies while advising on foreign policy.
